name: Boiler controls and oxygen trim
description: Control system that holds the fuel-to-air ratio and steam conditions across load. A stand-alone PLC oxygen-trim package uses an O2 sensor, firing-rate sensor and actuator or variable-speed drive to compensate for temperature, barometric pressure and fuel changes; package burners add parallel positioning, remote monitoring and burner-management interlocks.

specifications.basis: Stand-alone PLC-based system: O2 sensor + firing-rate sensor + PLC panel + actuator or VSD
Air trim or fuel trim; single-point/jackshaft with customisation for parallel positioning or alternate fuel
Compensates for temperature, barometric pressure and fuel changes
Parallel positioning and remote IoT monitoring included on ProFire SBR-30/SBR-5
Interlocks/permissives, flame presence monitoring, safety-limit supervision, prepurge and controlled shutdown

gaps.what: measured savings and set-point accuracy for O2 trim on gas boilers
gaps.why: Read pages describe architecture and compensation but give no savings or accuracy figures.
gaps.next_action: Find a controlled trial or OEM datasheet stating O2 set point and fuel saving.
